findings.title: Exit codes changed by this PR are not asserted in any test
findings.body: The documented contract of `update-compatibility check` is its exit code: update-compatibility.adoc tells consumers to rely only on the exit code (0 = rolling possible, 3 = recreate required, 4 = feature disabled). This PR changes `CompatibilityResult.RECREATE_UPGRADE_EXIT_CODE` from 4 to 3 and introduces `FEATURE_DISABLED = 4`, but `UpdateCommandDistTest` only asserts log text. `testFeatureNotEnabled` (line 49) and `testWrongVersions` (lines 97 and 106) never call `result.exitCode()`; `testCompatible` is the only test checking a code (0). A regression in the 3/4 codes would pass CI unnoticed. Add `assertEquals(4, ...)` for the feature-disabled case and `assertEquals(3, ...)` for the incompatible-version cases.

findings.title: Default (null) strategy cases do not enable rolling-updates that the new docs call mandatory
findings.body: `createInitialDeployment` returns early when `updateStrategy` is null, so `testImageChange(null)` and `testCacheMaxCount(null)` run against a CR that does not enable the `rolling-updates` feature. The docs added in this PR (advanced-configuration.adoc CAUTION) state the feature must be enabled or the Operator will fail, and `testCacheMaxCount(null)` expects a rolling update on a configuration change — behavior the flag is supposed to gate. Unless `getTestKeycloakDeployment(true)` already enables preview features, these two parameterized cases will either fail or silently exercise the un-gated path. Enable the feature for the null case as well, or reconcile the documentation with the actual behavior.

findings.title: setEnabledFeatures replaces any existing enabled features on the test deployment
findings.body: After creating a `FeatureSpec` only when it is null, the code calls `setEnabledFeatures(List.of(ROLLING_UPDATES.getKey()))`, which overwrites the entire enabled-features list. If `getTestKeycloakDeployment(true)` returns a CR that already enables other features needed by the deployment (the null check implies a non-null FeatureSpec is possible), adding rolling-updates silently drops them and changes what the test actually deploys. Append to the existing list (or assert it is empty) instead of replacing it.
